tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create Project
tools.description: Creates a new project with the given name and project type.

format.description: Project format ID from Blockbench's Formats registry.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.title: Get Project Info
tools.description: Returns read-only project orientation: format id and display name, project name/UUID, texture resolution (texture_width/height), element counts, and a summary of top-level groups.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: Lists every open Blockbench project tab, its active state, read-only state, and whether MCP model mutations are allowed.

tools.name: select_project
tools.title: Select Project
tools.description: Selects an open project tab in Blockbench by exact UUID, exact save path, or unique exact name.

project.description: Project UUID, exact name, or exact save path.

tools.name: save_project
tools.title: Save Project
tools.description: Saves the visible project as a portable .bbmodel, using its current save path unless an absolute path is supplied.

path.description: Optional absolute .bbmodel path. Omit it to use the visible project's current save path.

tools.name: set_project_read_only
tools.title: Set Project Read Only
tools.description: Turns the visible project's read-only lock on or off for both the user and MCP while preserving tab switching and camera navigation.

read_only.description: true blocks model editing and saving while view navigation remains available; false removes the explicit lock.

tools.name: set_project_texture_resolution
tools.title: Set Project Texture Resolution
tools.description: Sets the visible project's texture resolution. Existing UV coordinates are preserved unless modify_uv is explicitly true.

modify_uv.description: Whether to scale existing UV coordinates with the resolution change. Defaults to false so geometry UVs are preserved.

tools.name: close_project_without_saving
tools.title: Close Project Without Saving
tools.description: Closes the Blockbench tab visible when the call begins and explicitly discards its unsaved changes.

tools.name: open_bbmodel
tools.title: Open BBModel
tools.description: Validates and opens one absolute local .bbmodel file as a new Blockbench project tab. Remote URLs and oversized/invalid JSON are rejected before Blockbench state changes; the result identifies the exact new tab.

path.description: Absolute local .bbmodel path or file:// URL. HTTP(S) is rejected.

name.description: Optional tab name override after the project opens.

tools.name: duplicate_project
tools.title: Duplicate Project
tools.description: Copies an entire open project—including hierarchy, geometry, textures, UVs, animations, and project metadata—through Blockbench's portable project codec into a new unsaved tab. The source project is not modified.

name.description: Name for the unsaved duplicate tab. Defaults to '<source> copy'.

tools.name: inspect_capabilities
tools.title: Inspect Capabilities
tools.description: Reports the running Blockbench version, installed model formats and their actual feature flags (meshes, splines, armatures, controllers, UV, materials and more), plus available editor modes. With a project open, current_format identifies the visible tab's capabilities.

tools.name: remove_element
tools.title: Remove Element
tools.description: Removes the element with the given ID.

id.description: ID or name of the element to remove.

tools.name: add_group
tools.title: Add Group
tools.description: Adds a new group at the Outliner root unless a parent group or bone is supplied.

origin.description: Pivot point of the group as [x, y, z].

rotation.description: Rotation of the group in degrees as [x, y, z].

parent.description: Parent UUID or unique name. Defaults to the Outliner root.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

tools.name: list_outline
tools.title: List Outline
tools.description: Returns the project outline as a hierarchical tree. Each node reports { name, uuid, type (cube|mesh|group), children? }. Groups contain child cubes, meshes, and sub-groups. Use `include_cubes=false` to get a group-only skeleton when you just need structure, or `max_depth` to bound very deep trees.

include_cubes.description: If true, include cubes as leaves. If false, return groups only.

include_meshes.description: If true, include meshes as leaves. If false, omit meshes.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth to traverse. Use a small value to summarize large projects.

tools.name: duplicate_element
tools.title: Duplicate Element
tools.description: Duplicates a cube, mesh, or group beside the original by default while preserving geometry, UVs, textures, and descendants. You may choose another parent, offset the duplicate, or assign a new name.

id.description: ID or name of the element to duplicate.

parent.description: Target parent UUID or unique name. Defaults to the original element's parent.

tools.name: rename_element
tools.title: Rename Element
tools.description: Renames a cube, mesh or group by ID or name.

id.description: ID or name of the element to rename.

tools.name: find_elements_by_criteria
tools.title: Find Elements by Criteria
tools.description: Searches the current project for elements matching the given criteria. Supports name pattern matching (regex or substring), type filtering, scoping to a parent group, cube size ranges, and selection scope. Returns element metadata, never modifies state.

name_pattern.description: Regex pattern to match element names (e.g., '^arm_.*'). Case-sensitive.

name_contains.description: Substring to match in element names. Case-insensitive.

type.description: Restrict to a single element type.

parent_group.description: UUID or name of a parent group. Only descendants of this group are returned.

min_size.description: Minimum [x,y,z] size for cubes. Cubes smaller on any axis are excluded.

max_size.description: Maximum [x,y,z] size for cubes. Cubes larger on any axis are excluded.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: select_all_of_type
tools.title: Select All of Type
tools.description: Selects all elements of the given type (cube, mesh, or group) in the current project. Optionally restrict to descendants of a parent group, or add to (rather than replace) the current selection.

add_to_selection.description: If true, add to current selection. If false, replace selection.

parent_group.description: UUID or name of a parent group. If provided, only descendants of this group are selected.

tools.name: filter_by_material
tools.title: Filter Elements by Material
tools.description: Returns all elements that reference the given texture. For cubes, includes the list of face keys (e.g., 'north', 'up') that use the texture. For meshes, returns the mesh if any face uses the texture.

texture.description: Texture ID, UUID or name to search for.

include_face_keys.description: Include the list of cube face keys (e.g., 'north') that reference the texture.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.title: Get Selection
tools.description: Returns selected cube/mesh/group identities, each selected mesh's vertex/edge/face keys, and the active texture.

tools.name: modify_group
tools.title: Modify Group
tools.description: Updates an ordinary Outliner group/bone. origin changes only its pivot; rotation sets its local Euler rotation; position translates the entire subtree so the group origin reaches an absolute model-space coordinate. The affected subtree is captured in one Undo edit and read back before success.

origin.description: Set the group's model-space pivot directly without translating descendants.

rotation.description: Set the group's local Euler rotation in degrees [x, y, z].

position.description: Move the complete subtree so the group's model-space origin reaches this absolute [x, y, z] position.

tools.name: reparent_element
tools.title: Reparent Element
tools.description: Moves one cube, mesh, or group to an explicit parent and preserves its rendered world transform by default.

id.description: Element or group UUID or unique name.

parent.description: Required target parent UUID or unique name. Use the exact literal 'root' only for intentional root placement.

preserve_world_transform.description: Keep the node and its descendants in the same rendered world-space pose.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.title: List Collections
tools.description: Lists Blockbench Collections, which organize elements independently from the Outliner and bone hierarchy.

tools.name: edit_collection
tools.title: Edit Collection
tools.description: Creates, renames, replaces the members of, or removes one editor-only Collection without changing Outliner parents or bones.

collection.description: Collection UUID or unique name. Required for update and remove.

members.description: Replacement member UUIDs or unique names. An empty array clears membership.

items.description: ID or name of the element.

tools.name: inspect_element_types
tools.title: Inspect Element Types
tools.description: Lists registered Blockbench element types, their format requirements, and editable native properties. Property names and enum values come from the installed Blockbench and plugins.

tools.name: create_element
tools.title: Create Element
tools.description: Creates a registered element from its native properties, including locators, null objects, texture meshes, billboards, bounding boxes and splines. Use inspect_element_types for properties; use the dedicated cube, mesh and armature tools for their geometry and hierarchy. New elements default to the Outliner root.

tools.name: edit_element_properties
tools.title: Edit Element Properties
tools.description: Changes declared native properties on one element or group, with type and enum validation. Supports transforms and settings on locators, null objects, billboards, splines, meshes and other registered types. Use dedicated geometry, UV, reparenting and spline-point tools for structural changes.

tools.name: inspect_element
tools.title: Inspect Element
tools.description: Reads one element or group's native saved properties. Geometry is omitted by default; request it to read cube faces, bounding-box extents or spline control points. Large meshes should use the focused mesh resources.

tools.name: set_bounding_box
tools.title: Set Bounding Box
tools.description: Sets the from/to extents of an existing bounding_box element in model coordinates. Create the element with create_element first. Each to component must be at least its from component.

tools.name: set_spline_points
tools.title: Set Spline Points
tools.description: Replaces a spline's ordered Bezier handles and segments, preserving its texture and other properties. Points and control points use element-local coordinates; cyclic connects the last handle to the first. Returns native keys for readback.

control_before.description: Incoming Bezier control point in element-local coordinates; defaults to position.

control_after.description: Outgoing Bezier control point in element-local coordinates; defaults to position.

tools.name: create_cube
tools.title: Create Cube
tools.description: Places one or more cubes. They are created at the Outliner root unless a parent group or bone is supplied.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply to the cube.

group.description: Parent group/bone UUID or unique name. Defaults to the Outliner root.

faces.description: Faces to apply the texture to. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.

anyOf.description: Array of faces to apply the texture to.
Whether to apply the texture to all faces. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.

face.description: Face to apply the texture to.

uv.description: Custom UV mapping for the face.

anyOf.description: Array of faces with custom UV mapping.

tools.name: edit_cube
tools.title: Edit Cube
tools.description: Modifies the cube with the given ID. Auto UV setting: saved as an integer, where 0 means disabled, 1 means enabled, and 2 means relative auto UV (cube position affects UV)

id.description: ID or name of the cube to modify. Defaults to selected, which could be more than one.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

shade.description: Whether to apply shading to the cube.

color.description: Single digit to represent a color from a palette.

visibility.description: Whether the cube is visible or not.

tools.name: edit_cube_uv
tools.title: Edit Cube UV
tools.description: Atomically updates Box UV offsets and/or per-face UV rectangles for up to 500 existing cubes. All cube references are resolved before mutation, duplicate targets are refused, explicit face rectangles switch to per-face UV mode, and every requested value is read back before success.

face_uv.description: Per-face UV rectangles [u1, v1, u2, v2]. Supplying any face automatically switches the cube to per-face UV mode.

uv_mode.description: Preserve or explicitly set the cube UV mode.

updates.description: Cube UV updates resolved and committed as one atomic Undo edit.

tools.name: place_mesh
tools.title: Place Mesh
tools.description: Places one or more meshes at the Outliner root unless a parent group or bone is supplied.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply to the mesh.

group.description: Parent group/bone UUID or unique name. Defaults to the Outliner root.

tools.name: extrude_mesh
tools.title: Extrude Mesh
tools.description: Extrudes selected faces or edges of a mesh.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

mode.description: What to extrude: faces, edges, or vertices.

tools.name: subdivide_mesh
tools.title: Subdivide Mesh
tools.description: Subdivides selected faces of a mesh to create more geometry.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

cuts.description: Number of subdivision cuts to make.

tools.name: create_sphere
tools.title: Create Sphere
tools.description: Creates one or more sphere meshes at the Outliner root unless a parent is supplied. The spheres use vertices and faces generated from spherical coordinates.

sides.description: Number of horizontal divisions (affects sphere quality).

align_edges.description: Whether to align edges for better geometry.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply to the sphere.

group.description: Parent group/bone UUID or unique name. Defaults to the Outliner root.

tools.name: select_mesh_elements
tools.title: Select Mesh Elements
tools.description: Selects vertices, edges, or faces of a mesh for manipulation.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh to select elements from.

elements.description: Specific elements to select. If not provided, selects all.

anyOf.description: Vertex key, edge as 'vkey1-vkey2', or face key

action.description: Selection action: select (replace), add, remove, or toggle.

tools.name: move_mesh_vertices
tools.title: Move Mesh Vertices
tools.description: Moves selected vertices of a mesh by the specified offset.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

offset.description: Offset to move vertices by [x, y, z].

vertices.description: Specific vertex keys to move. If not provided, moves all selected vertices.

tools.name: delete_mesh_elements
tools.title: Delete Mesh Elements
tools.description: Deletes selected vertices, edges, or faces from a mesh.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

mode.description: What to delete: vertices, edges, or faces.

keep_vertices.description: When deleting faces/edges, whether to keep the vertices.

tools.name: merge_mesh_vertices
tools.title: Merge Mesh Vertices
tools.description: Merges vertices that are within a specified distance of each other.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh.

threshold.description: Maximum distance between vertices to merge.

selected_only.description: Whether to only merge selected vertices.

tools.name: create_mesh_face
tools.title: Create Mesh Face
tools.description: Creates a new face from selected vertices.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

vertices.description: Vertex keys to create face from. Must be 3 or 4 vertices.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply to the new face.

tools.name: create_cylinder
tools.title: Create Cylinder
tools.description: Creates one or more cylinder meshes with optional end caps at the Outliner root unless a parent is supplied.

texture.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

group.description: Parent group/bone UUID or unique name. Defaults to the Outliner root.

tools.name: knife_tool
tools.title: Knife Tool
tools.description: Uses the knife tool to cut custom edges into mesh faces.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh to cut.

face.description: Existing face key containing this mesh-local cut point.

tools.name: create_pyramid
tools.title: Create Pyramid
tools.description: Creates sealed low-poly pyramids or cones from a polygon base and apex; sides=3 gives a tetrahedron-like primitive.

base_center.description: Center of the polygon base in model coordinates.

sides.description: 3 creates a tetrahedron-like pyramid; larger values create a low-poly cone.

texture.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

group.description: Parent group/bone UUID or unique name. Defaults to the Outliner root.

tools.name: list_armatures
tools.title: List Armatures
tools.description: Lists all armatures in the current project with their basic info.

tools.name: get_armature
tools.title: Get Armature
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a specific armature including its bones.

id.description: UUID or name of the armature.

include_bones.description: Whether to include bone hierarchy in response.

tools.name: add_armature
tools.title: Add Armature
tools.description: Creates a new root-level armature. An armature is a skeletal rig used for mesh deformation.

parent.description: Armatures are always created at the Outliner root.

add_initial_bone.description: Whether to add an initial bone to the armature.

tools.name: remove_armature
tools.title: Remove Armature
tools.description: Removes an armature and all its bones from the project.

id.description: UUID or name of the armature to remove.

tools.name: update_armature
tools.title: Update Armature
tools.description: Updates properties of an existing armature.

id.description: UUID or name of the armature.

tools.name: list_armature_bones
tools.title: List Armature Bones
tools.description: Lists all armature bones, optionally filtered by a specific armature.

armature_id.description: Filter bones by armature UUID or name. If not provided, lists all bones.

tools.name: get_armature_bone
tools.title: Get Armature Bone
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a specific armature bone.

id.description: UUID or name of the bone.

include_weights.description: Whether to include all vertex weights in response.

tools.name: add_armature_bone
tools.title: Add Armature Bone
tools.description: Creates a new bone and adds it to an armature or parent bone.

parent_id.description: UUID or name of parent armature or bone.

origin.description: Position of the bone. Defaults to [0, parent.length, 0] for child bones.

connected.description: Whether bone is connected to parent.

tools.name: remove_armature_bone
tools.title: Remove Armature Bone
tools.description: Removes an armature bone from the project.

id.description: UUID or name of the bone to remove.

remove_children.description: Whether to also remove child bones.

tools.name: update_armature_bone
tools.title: Update Armature Bone
tools.description: Updates an armature bone. Visibility is editor-session-only in Blockbench; the other supported properties are project data.

id.description: UUID or name of the bone.

rotation.description: New rotation [x, y, z] in degrees.

visibility.description: Editor-session visibility. Blockbench does not store this ArmatureBone property in project files.

tools.name: update_armature_bones_batch
tools.title: Update Armature Bones (Batch)
tools.description: Updates multiple armature bones. Visibility is editor-session-only in Blockbench; locked and color are project data.

items.description: ID or name of the element.

ids.description: Array of bone UUIDs or names to update.

visibility.description: Editor-session visibility. Blockbench does not store this ArmatureBone property in project files.

tools.name: select_armature_bones
tools.title: Select Armature Bones
tools.description: Selects armature bones by ID. Can select single bone, multiple bones, or bone hierarchy.

ids.description: Array of bone UUIDs or names to select.

items.description: ID or name of the element.

armature_id.description: Select all bones in this armature.

include_descendants.description: Include all descendant bones in selection.

tools.name: get_vertex_weights
tools.title: Get Vertex Weights
tools.description: Gets vertex weights for a mesh from all bones affecting it.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

tools.name: set_vertex_weights_batch
tools.title: Set Vertex Weights (Batch)
tools.description: Sets multiple vertex weights at once on a bone.

bone_id.description: UUID or name of the bone.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

tools.name: clear_vertex_weights
tools.title: Clear Vertex Weights
tools.description: Clears all vertex weights from a bone for a specific mesh.

bone_id.description: UUID or name of the bone.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

tools.name: list_animations
tools.title: List Animations
tools.description: Lists animations and reports which one is currently selected.

tools.name: get_animation
tools.title: Get Animation
tools.description: Returns one animation with its animators and keyframes.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or exact name. Defaults to the selected animation.

tools.name: manage_animation
tools.title: Manage Animation
tools.description: Selects, renames, or removes one animation by exact UUID or name.

tools.name: create_animation
tools.title: Create Animation
tools.description: Creates a new animation with keyframes for bones.

animation_length.description: Length of the animation in seconds

particle_effects.description: Particle effects with timestamps as keys

tools.name: manage_keyframes
tools.title: Manage Keyframes
tools.description: Creates, deletes, or edits keyframes in the animation timeline for specific bones and channels.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Name of the bone/group to manage keyframes for.

time.description: Time in seconds for the keyframe.

values.description: Values: [x,y,z] for position/rotation, number for uniform scale.

bezier_handles.description: Bezier handle positions for bezier interpolation.

tools.name: animation_graph_editor
tools.title: Animation Graph Editor
tools.description: Controls animation curves in the graph editor for fine-tuning animations.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Name of the bone/group to modify curves for.

action.description: Type of curve modification to apply.

keyframe_range.description: Time range to apply the curve modification. If not provided, applies to all keyframes.

custom_curve.description: Custom bezier curve control points (only for 'custom' action).

tools.name: bone_rigging
tools.title: Bone Rigging
tools.description: Creates and manipulates the bone structure (rig) of a model for animation.

action.description: Action to perform on the bone structure.

name.description: UUID or unique name of the bone.

parent.description: Target parent UUID or unique name. Creating defaults to root, mirroring defaults to the original parent, and only the parent action requires this field.

new_name.description: Required replacement name for the rename action.

children.description: UUIDs or unique names of existing nodes to move into a newly created bone.

ik_enabled.description: Enable inverse kinematics for this bone.

ik_target.description: Target bone UUID or unique name for the IK chain.

mirror_axis.description: Axis to mirror the bone across.

tools.name: animation_timeline
tools.title: Animation Timeline
tools.description: Controls the animation timeline, including playback, time scrubbing, and timeline settings.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

length.description: Animation length in seconds (for set_length action).

tools.name: batch_keyframe_operations
tools.title: Batch Keyframe Operations
tools.description: Performs batch operations on multiple keyframes at once.

scale_factor.description: Scale factor for time or values.

tools.name: copy_animation_keyframes
tools.title: Animation Copy/Paste
tools.description: Copies keyframes directly between bones or animations, optionally mirroring them, without a stored clipboard step.

time_range.description: Time range to copy. If not provided, copies all keyframes.

mirror_axis.description: Optional axis to mirror while copying.

tools.name: inspect_animation_controllers
tools.title: Inspect Animation Controllers
tools.description: Lists animation controllers in the visible project, or reads one controller's state graph, initial state, transitions, effects and blend settings.

tools.name: create_animation_controller
tools.title: Create Animation Controller
tools.description: Creates an animation controller with an explicit graph of named states. Animation references must already exist; transitions resolve before any edit. Requires a format supporting animation controllers. Does not start playback or write files.

animation.description: An existing animation UUID or unambiguous exact name.

tools.name: edit_animation_controller
tools.title: Edit Animation Controller
tools.description: Renames an animation controller, changes its initial state, or replaces its complete state graph. Providing states replaces omitted states too; omitting states preserves the graph. Existing state UUIDs are preserved by name. Changes stay in the project until explicitly exported.

animation.description: An existing animation UUID or unambiguous exact name.

tools.name: remove_animation_controller
tools.title: Remove Animation Controller
tools.description: Removes one controller from the visible project with Undo support. Leaves any existing animation-controller file on disk intact.

tools.name: inspect_animation_codecs
tools.title: Inspect Animation Codecs
tools.description: Lists the installed native AnimationCodec registry with import/compile support and the current format's default. Includes codecs contributed by other plugins.

tools.name: import_animations
tools.title: Import Animations
tools.description: Imports an animation file into the visible project through the current native AnimationCodec.loadFile API, with Undo. Accepts inline content or an absolute local file; optional names filter uses file animation IDs. Existing same-name animations/controllers are rejected for Bedrock JSON. Does not save or replace source files.

content.description: Inline file content. Provide content or path, not both.

path.description: Absolute local source path; remote URLs are not supported.

tools.name: export_animations
tools.title: Export Animations
tools.description: Compiles named animations or controllers with the installed native AnimationCodec API. Returns content and optionally writes the exact output to an absolute path. Existing files require overwrite=true and are replaced in full; no implicit merge or save dialog. Controller export uses bedrock_animation_controller by default.

tools.name: get_display_transform
tools.title: Get Display Transform
tools.description: Reads Java Edition display transforms from Project.display_settings. Returns one slot or every populated slot without modifying the model.

slot.description: Display slot to read. Omit to return all populated slots.

tools.name: set_display_transform
tools.title: Set Display Transform
tools.description: Writes one Java Edition display transform with complete Undo and audit coverage. This changes exported model data and requires a format with display-mode support.

translation.description: Translation offset as [x, y, z] in Minecraft display units.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees as [x, y, z].

mirror.description: Per-axis mirror flags as [x, y, z].

reset.description: Reset the slot to its identity transform before applying supplied fields.

tools.name: enter_display_mode
tools.title: Enter Display Mode
tools.description: Switches the editor preview to a display slot, optionally loads a validated reference model, and returns a screenshot for multi-view fit checks. It does not change exported transform data.

reference.description: Optional live reference model name, such as player, zombie, armor_stand, or block.

tools.name: capture_viewport
tools.title: Inspect Viewport
tools.description: Captures the visible project with optional one-shot camera, animation, and bone visibility settings.

settle_frames.description: Render frames to wait before capture. Use 0 only when the scene is already stable.

camera.description: Optional one-shot camera for this capture.

fov.description: Perspective vertical field of view in degrees.

viewport.description: Stored offscreen viewport [width, height], with width <= 1600 and height <= 1200.

element.description: UUID or unique name to frame.

view_direction.description: World direction from the target toward the camera.

preview.description: Optional one-shot animation pose and bone visibility for this capture.

animation.description: Exact animation UUID or unique name. Omit for the default pose.

hide_bones.description: Bones to hide in this capture.

show_bones.description: Bones to show in this capture.

only_bones.description: If non-empty, isolates these bones with their ancestors and descendants in this capture.

tools.name: capture_blockbench_ui
tools.title: Inspect Blockbench UI
tools.description: Returns the image data of the Blockbench app.

tools.name: get_camera_state
tools.title: Get MCP Camera State
tools.description: Returns the effective camera for the visible project with exact projection, FOV/zoom, viewport, and project identity.

tools.name: create_texture
tools.title: Create Texture
tools.description: Creates a new texture with the given name and size.

width.description: Explicit output width. Omit with data to preserve the source image width.

height.description: Explicit output height. Omit with data to preserve the source image height.

data.description: Path to the image file or data URL.

fill_color.description: RGBA color to fill the texture, as tuple or HEX string.

layer_name.description: Name of the texture layer. Required if fill_color is set.

pbr_channel.description: PBR channel to use for the texture. Color, normal, height, or Metalness/Emissive/Roughness (MER) map.

render_mode.description: Render mode for the texture. Default, emissive, additive, or layered.

render_sides.description: Render sides for the texture. Auto, front, or double.

tools.name: apply_texture
tools.title: Apply Texture
tools.description: Applies the given texture to the element with the specified ID.

id.description: ID or name of the element to apply the texture to.

texture.description: ID or name of the texture to apply.

applyTo.description: Face scope: all faces, only blank/unresolved faces, or (none) the currently selected faces of per-face UV elements. Box UV elements always apply as a whole.

tools.name: add_texture_group
tools.title: Add Texture Group
tools.description: Adds a new texture group with the given name.

textures.description: Array of texture IDs or names to add to the group.

is_material.description: Whether the texture group is a PBR material or not.

tools.name: list_textures
tools.title: List Textures
tools.description: Returns a list of all textures in the Blockbench editor.

tools.name: get_texture
tools.title: Get Texture
tools.description: Returns the image data of the given texture or default texture.

texture.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

tools.name: create_pbr_material
tools.title: Create PBR Material
tools.description: Creates a new PBR material (texture group with is_material=true) and optionally assigns textures to PBR channels. Use this for Minecraft Bedrock resource packs or any format supporting PBR.

color_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the color (albedo) channel.

normal_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the normal map channel.

height_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the height/displacement map channel.

mer_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the MER (Metalness/Emissive/Roughness) channel.

color_value.description: Uniform RGBA color [R,G,B,A] when no color texture is provided.

mer_value.description: Uniform MER values [Metalness, Emissive, Roughness] (0-255) when no MER texture is provided.

subsurface_value.description: Subsurface scattering value (0-255) for Bedrock 1.21.30+ materials.

tools.name: configure_material
tools.title: Configure Material
tools.description: Configures an existing PBR material's properties including channel assignments, uniform values, and subsurface scattering.

material.description: Material name or UUID to configure.

color_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the color channel, or 'none' to use uniform color.

normal_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the normal map, or 'none' to remove.

height_texture.description: Texture ID/name for the height map, or 'none' to remove.

mer_texture.description: Texture ID/name for MER channel, or 'none' to use uniform values.

color_value.description: Uniform RGBA color [R,G,B,A] when no color texture.

tools.name: list_materials
tools.title: List Materials
tools.description: Lists all PBR materials (texture groups with is_material=true) and their assigned textures per channel.

tools.name: get_material_info
tools.title: Get Material Info
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a PBR material including the compiled texture_set.json preview for Bedrock export.

tools.name: import_texture_set
tools.title: Import Texture Set
tools.description: Imports a Minecraft Bedrock texture_set.json file and creates a PBR material with the associated textures.

path.description: Path to the .texture_set.json file to import.

tools.name: assign_texture_channel
tools.title: Assign Texture Channel
tools.description: Assigns a texture to a specific PBR channel within a material.

texture.description: Texture name or UUID to assign.

channel.description: PBR channel to assign the texture to.

tools.name: save_material_config
tools.title: Save Material Config
tools.description: Saves the material's texture_set.json file to disk (Bedrock format). Requires the color texture to have a valid file path.

material.description: Material name or UUID to save.

tools.name: remove_texture
tools.title: Remove Texture
tools.description: Removes an entire texture from the visible project. If it is referenced, supply a replacement texture or explicitly clear references; otherwise the operation refuses before mutation. Reference rewrites and removal share one Undo transaction.

texture.description: ID, UUID, or unique name of the texture to remove.

replacement.description: Optional replacement texture. Every face/group reference is changed atomically before removal.

clear_references.description: Explicitly clear all face/group references when no replacement is supplied. Referenced textures are otherwise refused.

tools.name: configure_texture
tools.title: Configure Texture
tools.description: Edits one texture's name, animated-frame timing/order/interpolation or wrapping with Undo. Uses the visible project's texture; no source file is saved. Texture animation settings require animated_textures and wrapping requires per_texture_wrap_mode in the current format.

tools.name: resize_texture
tools.title: Resize Texture
tools.description: Resizes the complete texture bitmap, including layers, using nearest-neighbor scaling or a top-left canvas crop/expansion. Width and height refer to the full image including all animation frames. Logical UV dimensions and coordinates stay unchanged; use set_project_texture_resolution or UV tools when those also need changing. No linked source file is written.

tools.name: edit_texture_pixels
tools.title: Edit Exact Texture Pixels
tools.description: Applies exact RGBA values to texture pixels inside Blockbench so the user can see the change immediately and undo it normally.

texture_id.description: Texture ID, UUID, or name. Defaults to the active/default texture.

pixels.description: Exact canvas pixels in top-left-origin texture coordinates.

tools.name: paint_fill_tool
tools.title: Paint Fill Tool
tools.description: Uses the fill/bucket tool to fill areas with color.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

tools.name: draw_shape_tool
tools.title: Draw Shape Tool
tools.description: Draws geometric shapes on textures.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

shape.description: Shape to draw. '_h' suffix means hollow.

tools.name: gradient_tool
tools.title: Gradient Tool
tools.description: Applies gradients to textures.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

tools.name: color_picker_tool
tools.title: Color Picker Tool
tools.description: Picks colors from textures and sets them as the active color.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

x.description: X coordinate to pick color from.

y.description: Y coordinate to pick color from.

set_as_secondary.description: Set as secondary color instead of primary.

pick_opacity.description: Also pick and apply the pixel's opacity.

tools.name: copy_brush_tool
tools.title: Copy Brush Tool
tools.description: Uses the copy/clone brush to copy texture areas.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

x.description: Source X coordinate to copy from.

y.description: Source Y coordinate to copy from.

x.description: Target X coordinate to paste to.

y.description: Target Y coordinate to paste to.

tools.name: eraser_tool
tools.title: Eraser Tool
tools.description: Erases parts of textures with customizable settings.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

coordinates.description: Array of coordinates to erase at.

connect_strokes.description: Whether to connect erase strokes with lines.

tools.name: paint_settings
tools.title: Paint Settings
tools.description: Configures paint mode settings and preferences.

x.description: X coordinate of texture mirror center.

y.description: Y coordinate of texture mirror center.

paint_side_restrict.description: Restrict painting to current face side.

paint_with_stylus_only.description: Only allow painting with stylus input.

pick_color_opacity.description: Pick opacity when using color picker.

tools.name: paint_with_brush
tools.title: Paint with Brush
tools.description: Paints on textures using the brush tool with customizable settings.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

coordinates.description: Array of coordinates to paint at.

connect_strokes.description: Whether to connect paint strokes with lines.

tools.name: create_brush_preset
tools.title: Create Brush Preset
tools.description: Creates a custom brush preset with specified settings.

tools.name: load_brush_preset
tools.title: Load Brush Preset
tools.description: Loads and applies a brush preset by name.

preset_name.description: Name of the brush preset to load.

tools.name: texture_selection
tools.title: Texture Selection
tools.description: Creates, modifies, or manipulates texture selections for painting.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

radius.description: Radius for expand or contract operations.

tools.name: texture_layer_management
tools.title: Texture Layer Management
tools.description: Creates, manages, and manipulates texture layers.

texture_id.description: Texture ID or name. If not provided, uses selected texture.

tools.name: get_face_material_instances
tools.title: Get Face Material Instances
tools.description: Gets the material instance names for cube faces. Material instances are used in Bedrock Block format to map faces to materials defined in the minecraft:material_instances component.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses the first selected cube.

faces.description: Specific faces to get/clear material instances for. If not provided, returns/clears all faces.

tools.name: list_material_instances
tools.title: List Material Instances
tools.description: Lists all unique material instance names used in the project. Returns the material instance names along with which cubes and faces use them.

tools.name: bulk_set_material_instances
tools.title: Bulk Set Material Instances
tools.description: Sets material instance names on multiple cubes at once. Useful for assigning different material instances to different faces across the project.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube.

faces.description: Faces to set the material instance on.

tools.name: clear_material_instances
tools.title: Clear Material Instances
tools.description: Clears (removes) material instance names from cube faces. Useful for resetting material assignments.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, clears from all selected cubes.

faces.description: Specific faces to clear. If not provided, clears all faces.

all_cubes.description: If true, clears material instances from all cubes in the project.

tools.name: set_mesh_uv
tools.title: Set Mesh UV
tools.description: Sets UV coordinates for mesh faces or vertices.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh.

face_key.description: Face key to set UV for.

uv_mapping.description: UV coordinates for each vertex of the face.

tools.name: auto_uv_mesh
tools.title: Auto UV Mesh
tools.description: Automatically generates UV mapping for selected mesh faces.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

mode.description: UV mapping mode: project from view, unwrap, cylinder, or sphere mapping.

faces.description: Specific face keys to UV map. If not provided, maps all selected faces.

tools.name: rotate_mesh_uv
tools.title: Rotate Mesh UV
tools.description: Rotates UV coordinates of selected mesh faces.

mesh_id.description: ID or name of the mesh. If not provided, uses selected mesh.

faces.description: Specific face keys to rotate UV for. If not provided, rotates all selected faces.

tools.name: inspect_spatial_relationships
tools.title: Inspect Spatial Relationships
tools.description: Reports parentage, world-space centers and bounds for Outliner nodes, then compares requested pairs along all three axes. It flags cases where a front/side/top projection overlaps while the hidden depth axis is separated. Semantic expectations are supplied by the caller; the tool does not guess which parts should connect.

elements.description: UUIDs or unique names whose world bounds should be reported.

pairs.description: Pairs whose axis gaps and projection/depth relationship should be compared.

first.description: UUID or unique name of the first Outliner node.

second.description: UUID or unique name of the second Outliner node.

expected_relation.description: Caller-supplied semantic expectation. The tool never guesses whether two parts should connect.

tolerance.description: Distance treated as touching, in model units.

tools.name: measure_geometry
tools.title: Measure Geometry
tools.description: Performs batch world-space measurements without changing the model: object pivots/bounds/sizes, exact closest rendered-surface distances when tractable, point and pivot distances, signed three-axis bounds gaps plus penetration depths, and directed or undirected angles between vectors or principal geometry axes. Every result identifies its coordinate space, unit, endpoints, and whether an exact-geometry or bounds fallback method was used.

elements.description: Nodes whose world pivot, bounds, size, and principal long axis should be reported.

distances.description: Point/pivot/center/surface distance measurements in world coordinates.

element.description: Outliner node UUID or unique name.
Outliner node UUID or unique name.
Outliner node whose actual rendered geometry surface should be used. Falls back to world bounds only when geometry is unavailable or too large for the bounded exact calculation.
Outliner node UUID or unique name.
Outliner node UUID or unique name.
Outliner node whose actual rendered geometry surface should be used. Falls back to world bounds only when geometry is unavailable or too large for the bounded exact calculation.
Outliner node whose principal geometry axis should be measured.
Outliner node whose principal geometry axis should be measured.

orientation.description: Undirected treats opposite axis directions as the same and returns 0-90 degrees; directed returns 0-180 degrees.

tolerance.description: Touching tolerance for bounds gap/penetration analysis.

tools.name: detect_coplanar_faces
tools.title: Detect Coplanar Faces
tools.description: Finds overlapping coplanar rendered triangles that can cause Z-fighting. Ordinary volume intersections without coplanar surface overlap are reported separately and are not mislabeled.

first.description: UUID or unique name of the first Outliner node.

second.description: UUID or unique name of the second Outliner node.

max_triangle_comparisons.description: Per-pair work limit for old or low-power computers.

tools.name: analyze_model_contacts
tools.title: Analyze Model Contacts
tools.description: Performs exact transformed OBB SAT for cube pairs and bounded triangle-BVH analysis for mesh pairs, including descendant pairs and explicit uncertainty.

tools.name: inspect_uv_integrity
tools.title: Inspect UV Integrity
tools.description: Inventories typed face UVs and detects mapping, bounds, sharing, overlap, mirror, pixel-footprint, and texel-density problems.

tools.name: create_validation_snapshot
tools.title: Create Validation Snapshot
tools.description: Creates an in-memory read-only evidence snapshot with component digests; it is not a save or model checkpoint, and each project retains its latest eight snapshots.

tools.name: diff_validation_snapshot
tools.title: Diff Validation Snapshot
tools.description: Diffs current transforms, geometry, UVs, textures, camera, and pose against a validation snapshot and identifies stale evidence.

tools.name: capture_validation_views
tools.title: Capture Validation Views
tools.description: Auto-frames repeatable named views and clone-only color/debug passes with exact camera metadata, pixel coverage, and occluder IDs.

tools.name: sweep_animation_validation
tools.title: Sweep Animation Validation
tools.description: Samples native animation poses offscreen, runs selected contact/hierarchy/bounds checks, reports first failure and motion envelopes, and restores preview state on every path.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undoes the most recent edit in the current project. Use `steps` to undo multiple edits in a single call. Returns the action(s) that were undone.

tools.name: redo
tools.title: Redo
tools.description: Redoes the most recently undone edit. Use `steps` to redo multiple edits in a single call. Returns the action(s) that were redone.

tools.name: get_undo_stack
tools.title: Get Undo Stack
tools.description: Returns the current undo/redo history: the list of edit entries, the current index, and which entries are undone vs. applied. Use this to inspect available undo/redo operations and find named checkpoints.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (most recent first).

tools.name: save_checkpoint
tools.title: Save Checkpoint
tools.description: Inserts a named marker into the undo history. The marker can later be located with `get_undo_stack` so the agent knows how many times to call `undo` to return to this state. Does not modify the project.

name.description: Descriptive name for the checkpoint. Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.

tools.name: import_bedrock_geometry
tools.title: Import Bedrock Geometry
tools.description: Imports existing Bedrock geometry from serialized JSON. With no open project it creates a Bedrock Entity project first; otherwise it imports into the visible project. Accepts inline JSON, JSON data URLs, and local files only; remote HTTP(S) fetching is disabled.

geojson.description: Inline Bedrock geometry JSON, a JSON data URL, or a local JSON file path. HTTP(S) URLs are intentionally rejected.

tools.name: inspect_import_formats
tools.title: Inspect Import Formats
tools.description: Lists registered model codecs that expose a parser and a target format, along with their native file extensions and input encoding. Use open_bbmodel for native project files and import_model for other text/JSON model formats.

tools.name: import_model
tools.title: Import Model
tools.description: Parses an existing text/JSON model into a new visible project using a registered codec's native parser and target format. Accepts inline content or an absolute local source path. Does not merge into an existing tab or save source files; use open_bbmodel for native .bbmodel projects. Discover supported codecs with inspect_import_formats.

content.description: Inline file content. Provide content or path, not both.

path.description: Absolute local source path; remote URLs are not supported.

tools.name: inspect_export_formats
tools.title: Inspect Export Formats
tools.description: Lists all registered export codecs with their id, display name, file extension, and whether they support compile/export. Use before `export_model` to pick a codec.

only_current_format.description: If true, only return codecs compatible with the current project's format.

tools.name: export_model
tools.title: Export Model
tools.description: Compiles the visible project through the named codec and returns the result as text. Optionally writes the compiled content to a filesystem path (requires user permission in Blockbench v5.0+). Use inspect_export_formats first to discover codec IDs.

codec_id.description: Codec ID to use for export (e.g., 'obj', 'gltf', 'project', 'bedrock'). If omitted, uses the current project format's codec. Use `inspect_export_formats` to see available IDs.

options.description: Codec-specific export options. Defaults to the codec's configured export options.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the compiled model to. Requires user permission (Blockbench v5.0+ prompts for 'fs' access). If omitted, content is returned in the response only.

max_content_length.description: Maximum number of characters to include in the returned `content` field. Use 0 to omit content entirely (useful when only writing to disk). Larger values risk exceeding MCP context limits.

tools.name: ysm_set_workspace
tools.title: Set Plugin Workspace
tools.description: Configures the plugin workspace used by optional YSM synchronization. Access remains folder-scoped.

path.description: Absolute plugin workspace path. Omit to report the current path.

tools.name: ysm_workspace_status
tools.title: YSM Workspace Status
tools.description: Reports the plugin workspace, open Blockbench tabs, read-only state, and YSM source bindings.

tools.name: ysm_bind_project
tools.title: Bind YSM Project
tools.description: Binds the visible Bedrock project to its YSM geometry, texture, manifest, and portable-project files. Source/live count differences are reported rather than requiring a bypass flag.

manifest.description: Workspace-relative YSM manifest. Defaults to ysm.json beside the models/textures directories when present.

texture.description: Workspace-relative texture path. Defaults to textures/default.png beside the model package.

bbmodel.description: Workspace-relative .bbmodel path. Defaults to the selected project's save path when scoped.

tools.name: ysm_save_project
tools.title: Save Bound YSM Project
tools.description: Synchronizes the live Blockbench project back to bound YSM geometry, texture, and portable .bbmodel files with internal external-change checks and atomic writes. Unknown YSM fields are preserved.

tools.name: ysm_unbind_project
tools.title: Unbind YSM Project
tools.description: Removes the persisted YSM source binding from an open project tab without changing model files.

tools.name: ysm_discover_documents
tools.title: Discover YSM Documents
tools.description: Discovers the manifest and referenced Molang-bearing YSM sidecars without rewriting them.

tools.name: ysm_list_molang_expressions
tools.title: List YSM Molang Expressions
tools.description: Inventories exact Molang locations, owners, source ranges, and hashes in a YSM package.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

tools.name: ysm_get_molang_catalog
tools.title: Get YSM Molang Catalog
tools.description: Queries the source-derived OpenYSM Molang symbol catalog and its audited provenance.

include_source_files.description: Include one explicitly paginated page of source-file provenance for the selected dialect.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

tools.name: ysm_parse_molang
tools.title: Parse YSM Molang
tools.description: Tokenizes and parses the audited YSM Molang grammar with source ranges and diagnostics.

tools.name: ysm_validate_molang
tools.title: Validate YSM Molang
tools.description: Validates syntax, source-backed symbols and arity, runtime availability, and inventoried bone ownership.

bindings.description: Runtime bindings as nested objects or flat dotted paths. A flat dotted entry overrides the equivalent nested value.

tools.name: ysm_simulate_molang
tools.title: Simulate YSM Molang
tools.description: Evaluates a deterministic sequence with explicit bindings, timestep, and serializable state.

bindings.description: Runtime bindings as nested objects or flat dotted paths. A flat dotted entry overrides the equivalent nested value.
Per-step bindings as nested objects or flat dotted paths. A flat dotted entry overrides the equivalent nested value.

tools.name: ysm_preview_molang
tools.title: Preview YSM Molang
tools.description: Produces a bounded clone-safe Molang sample trace; it never changes saved model or visible editor state.

bindings.description: Runtime bindings as nested objects or flat dotted paths. A flat dotted entry overrides the equivalent nested value.
Per-step bindings as nested objects or flat dotted paths. A flat dotted entry overrides the equivalent nested value.

tools.name: preview_ysm_molang_edits
tools.title: Preview YSM Molang Edits
tools.description: Previews targeted Molang JSONC edits without writing the file.

expression_id.description: Current ID from ysm_list_molang_expressions; required for replace and remove.

json_pointer.description: Target JSON pointer. Required when creating a new expression.

tools.name: edit_ysm_molang
tools.title: Edit YSM Molang
tools.description: Atomically applies targeted Molang JSONC edits after a successful preview.

expression_id.description: Current ID from ysm_list_molang_expressions; required for replace and remove.

json_pointer.description: Target JSON pointer. Required when creating a new expression.

tools.name: hytale_get_format_info
tools.title: Get Hytale Format Info
tools.description: Returns information about the current Hytale format. Requires the Hytale plugin and a Hytale format project to be active.

tools.name: hytale_validate_model
tools.title: Validate Hytale Model
tools.description: Validates the current Hytale model against Hytale engine constraints (node count, UV sizes, etc.).

tools.name: hytale_set_cube_properties
tools.title: Set Hytale Cube Properties
tools.description: Sets Hytale-specific properties on a cube: shading_mode (flat, standard, fullbright, reflective) and double_sided.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.

shading_mode.description: Shading mode: flat (no lighting), standard (normal), fullbright (emissive), reflective

double_sided.description: Whether to render both sides of faces

tools.name: hytale_get_cube_properties
tools.title: Get Hytale Cube Properties
tools.description: Gets Hytale-specific properties from a cube (shading_mode, double_sided).

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.

tools.name: hytale_create_quad
tools.title: Create Hytale Quad
tools.description: Creates a Hytale quad at the Outliner root unless a parent group or bone is supplied.

group.description: Parent group/bone UUID or unique name. Defaults to the Outliner root.

tools.name: hytale_list_attachments
tools.title: List Hytale Attachments
tools.description: Lists all attachment collections in the current Hytale project.

tools.name: hytale_set_attachment_piece
tools.title: Set Attachment Piece
tools.description: Marks or unmarks a group as an attachment piece. Attachment pieces attach to like-named bones in the main model.

group_name.description: Name of the group to mark as attachment piece

is_piece.description: Whether the group is an attachment piece

tools.name: hytale_list_attachment_pieces
tools.title: List Attachment Pieces
tools.description: Lists all groups marked as attachment pieces.

tools.name: hytale_create_visibility_keyframe
tools.title: Create Visibility Keyframe
tools.description: Creates a visibility keyframe for a bone. Hytale supports toggling node visibility at keyframes.

time.description: Time in seconds for the keyframe

visible.description: Whether the bone is visible at this keyframe

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

tools.name: hytale_set_animation_loop
tools.title: Set Animation Loop Mode
tools.description: Sets the loop mode for a Hytale animation. Hytale supports "loop" (continuous) or "hold" (freeze on last frame).

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

loop_mode.description: Loop mode: loop (continuous), hold (freeze on last frame), once (play once)

tools.name: hytale_set_cube_stretch
tools.title: Set Cube Stretch
tools.description: Sets the stretch values for a cube. Hytale uses stretch instead of float sizes for better UV handling.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.

tools.name: hytale_get_cube_stretch
tools.title: Get Cube Stretch
tools.description: Gets the stretch values for a cube.

cube_id.description: ID or name of the cube. If not provided, uses selected cube.

prompts.name: model_creation_strategy
prompts.title: Model Creation Strategy
prompts.description: A staged Blockbench modeling workflow with explicit hierarchy, multi-view spatial checks, and human review checkpoints.

approach.description: Use direct incremental tools by default; import only when explicitly requested.

prompts.name: hytale_model_creation
prompts.title: Hytale Model Creation Guide
prompts.description: Comprehensive guide for creating Hytale character and prop models. Covers format selection, node limits, shading modes, stretch, quads, and best practices.

format_type.description: Which format type to focus on.

prompts.name: hytale_animation_workflow
prompts.title: Hytale Animation Workflow
prompts.description: Guide for creating animations for Hytale models. Covers 60 FPS timing, quaternion rotations, visibility keyframes, loop modes, and common animation patterns.

animation_type.description: Type of animation to focus on.

prompts.name: hytale_attachments
prompts.title: Hytale Attachments System
prompts.description: Guide for creating and managing attachments in Hytale models. Covers attachment collections, piece bones, modular equipment, and best practices.

resources.name: projects
resources.title: Blockbench Projects
resources.description: Returns information about available projects. List URIs use the slugified project name (e.g. `projects://my-character`) when unique, or `projects://<slug>~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: nodes
resources.title: Blockbench Nodes
resources.description: Returns 3D nodes from the visible project. Listed URIs include that project's UUID and can be read only while the same tab remains visible.

resources.name: textures
resources.title: Blockbench Textures
resources.description: Returns textures from the visible project. Listed URIs include that project's UUID; texture names must be unique when used instead of UUIDs.

resources.name: reference_models
resources.title: Reference Models
resources.description: Returns reference models from the visible project. Requires the Reference Models plugin.

resources.name: validator-status
resources.title: Validator Status
resources.description: Returns the current validation status including error/warning counts and a summary of all problems.

resources.name: validator-checks
resources.title: Validator Checks
resources.description: Returns information about registered validator checks. Use without an ID to list all checks, or provide a check ID to get details about a specific check.

resources.name: validator-warnings
resources.title: Validator Warnings
resources.description: Returns all current validation warnings with element references where available.

resources.name: validator-errors
resources.title: Validator Errors
resources.description: Returns all current validation errors with element references where available.

resources.name: hytale-format
resources.title: Hytale Format Information
resources.description: Returns format, block-size, node-limit, and feature information for the visible Hytale project.

resources.name: hytale-attachments
resources.title: Hytale Attachments
resources.description: Returns attachment collections from the visible Hytale project.

resources.name: hytale-pieces
resources.title: Hytale Attachment Pieces
resources.description: Returns groups marked as attachment pieces in the visible Hytale project.

resources.name: hytale-cubes
resources.title: Hytale Cubes
resources.description: Returns cubes and their Hytale-specific properties from the visible Hytale project.
